CODE
 Art. 2.3.82. 
Purposes 
The central register of matrimonial property agreements is a computerised database with the following purposes:
1¡ to make matrimonial property agreements enforceable against third parties, and to allow, within the limits specified in this subtitle, the consultation and communication to third parties, by electronic means or, where applicable, by post, of information relating to the matrimonial property agreements of married persons, including declarations of anticipated contribution, and to the property agreements of legal cohabitants;
 2¡ the processing, within the limits determined by Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC, of data recorded in the central register for purposes of general interest, and in particular for statistical and scientific purposes, or in order to improve the quality of the register.
